This ; method is now only responsible for getting info from ; the config file and then calling the procedure. ; ; ;- pro red::check_calibrations, all = all $ , darks = darks $ , flats = flats $ , polcal = polcal $ , pinholes = pinholes $ , logfile = logfile $ , science = science root_dir = self.root_dir red_check_calibrations, root_dir $ , all = all $ , darks = darks $ , flats = flats $ , polcal = polcal $ , pinholes = pinholes $ , logfile = logfile $ , science = science end
